intro: Bingles' Screwdriver is an essential engineering tool belonging to Bingles Blastenheimer, a gnome pilot who crashed his gyrocopter into the waters of Loch Modan. Following the crash, native troggs plundered the wreckage, scattering Bingles' tool buckets and specialized gear across the loch's northern islands.

p: When Bingles Blastenheimer plummeted into the Loch, he lost more than his flying machine—he lost the specialized equipment needed to repair it. Among the scattered gear was his trusty screwdriver, packed away inside one of several tool buckets snatched up by opportunistic troggs inhabiting the nearby isles. For an engineer stranded in the wilderness, fine adjustment tools like this screwdriver are irreplaceable, especially when assembling delicate gyrocopter mechanisms or handling volatile armaments.

Bingles is not merely a recreational aviator; he serves a larger cause dedicated to liberating the fallen city of Gnomeregan from troggs and leper gnomes. His mission relies on combining flight mechanics with his volatile Blastencapper munitions to deliver an aerial assault against the subterranean menace. Recovering this screwdriver alongside his wrench and hammer is crucial for putting his gyrocopter back together and keeping the gnomish airborne counteroffensive alive.
